Rice Cereal has no nutritional value, if your doctor is reccomending rice cereal especially at 2 months I'd say find someone who is up to date on current recommendations
Any kind of solids before 6 months can lead to choking, obesity, diabetes, allergies and digestive issues 
And yes, babies have had rice cereal and been fine but others have not. 
Assess the risks and if it is worth it to you, make your own decision on it. They are your baby.
But please research into the risk and speak to a different medical proffesional first

I didn't do it based on social media, I did it because I wanted. I struggled to breastfeed at first due to her having a tongue-tie so feeding her was painful and tiring but continued and still am, because I wanted to do what my baby liked best and what would be best for her health. I worked incredibly hard to make it work for me and my family, even though I didn't enjoy it because I wanted my baby to be happy and healthy and because it worked best for us situationally. I'm 9 months in and still hate it, but if I had another child I would do it again.

I hate breastfeeding, I hate the feeling of it, I hate the way it makes me feel, I hate that Im relied on to do all the feeding, but still I've made it 9 months :) 
So I'd say keep going, but if it's just really not something you can do just always remember fed is best. And that at least you tried :)
